items.title: Commit red-gap-log-provenance-chain.mjs as a registered red test and design the audited one-shot chain migration
items.context: Script + transcript in .proof-or-stop/evidence/red-proofs/2026-09-02-framework-defects (probe rp-mtk465sr-hoyapk, review rr-mtk4a7uu-t98f1q). Three causes: missing HMAC key (renamed at 4106eb3531, never migrated), 32 receipts with .lattice/ path literals, artifact absent at the canonical path in receipts[0].parentHead. Receipts are HMAC-bound so they cannot be rewritten; design a genesis-reset record citing the legacy ledger digest + parent head, re-key, canonicalize paths for new receipts; verifier stays strict (no .lattice alias, per proof-or-stop-residue rules).
items.userSees: GREEN red-gap-log-provenance-chain: the B-META gap-log provenance chain verifies; gap_log can extend it

items.title: Run the migration on this repository and prove gap_log appends again
items.context: Execute the one-shot migration command in the story worktree, commit the re-anchored ledger, then run proof-or-stop gap_log with a real source ref and show the receipt appended; add a doctor check that reports an unextendable chain with the migration command instead of the bare invalid_binding_shape error.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop gap_log prints the new B-META finding id and gap-log-provenance.jsonl gains one receipt
